title: Final Object Distance
description: Essential Criteria: The correct calculation of the object distance p_1 from the objective must be provided.

title: Final Magnifying Power
description: Essential Criteria: The correct magnifying power m must be calculated and presented.

title: Use of Lens Equation
description: Important Criteria: The application of the lens equation for both the objective and eyepiece must be shown clearly.

title: Distance Between Lenses
description: Important Criteria: The correct use of the distance between the lenses in calculations must be demonstrated.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: All distances and focal lengths must be expressed in consistent units throughout the solution.

title: Common Calculation Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any sign mistakes or incorrect application of the lens equation will result in a deduction.

title: Final Image Location
description: Important Criteria: The correct identification of the final image location for the eyepiece must be included.

title: Magnifying Power Derivation
description: Optional Criteria: A clear derivation of the magnifying power formula should be provided for full credit.
